text: Maya and Sam wanted Lake Tahoe. All they had was a guidebook.
So they turned it into a trip. Weather, drives, every booking, one screen.
Then they went. And it was everything.
Back home, they left a trail.
Half a world away, Rosa and Tomás found it. And said thank you.
They made it theirs. A slower morning, a little more soak.
They went. And they left a trail too.
Every trip here grew from another. Take a trip. Leave a trail.
